exercise.name: M0 bench readiness / dual-DAC QAM bring-up

status.release_gate: Tagged omariglol release containing f1cb86f is required before M0 can be marked complete; v0.1.9 is investigation-only.

omariglol.notes: Do not pin to an untagged branch. Rebuild/record when a tagged release containing f1cb86f is available.

dac.notes: In ALTER mode, freq_hz is per-channel. Treat loaded byte count as authoritative. ADC2 self-readback on DAC pins is not valid evidence.

rigol.notes: Not detected on USB in this pass. Use :DISP:TYPE DOTS, :DISP:CLE, brief :RUN, then :STOP for crisp X-Y captures. :AUT can leave acquisition stopped; follow with :RUN.

nanovna.notes: Not detected on USB in this pass. NanoVNAUSBFix USBTMC/SCPI image expected; verify with *IDN? when attached.
